name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Onboarding & Implementation Specialist | SaaS Launch, Training & Time to Value
summary: Customer onboarding and implementation specialist with 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments. Owned onboarding from post-sale handoff through configuration, training, and launch at Wix, launching 25+ customers a month at 110% of implementation targets while leading a team of onboarding specialists. At Birdeye, onboarded 15-20 reseller partners, many serving healthcare practices, and retained all but one. Runs every project on a clear plan: milestones, owners, timelines, and next steps that keep customers and internal teams accountable.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into technical configurations and delivering hands-on training.
Run discovery and onboarding for each client, setting goals, milestones, and timelines, and serving as the single point of contact through launch.
Configure CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot (segmentation, lifecycle stages, data hygiene) and document every interaction, timeline, and deliverable in the CRM and Notion.
Build automated onboarding workflows, reminders, and follow-ups that keep customers moving toward adoption without manual chasing.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts, coordinating execution across internal departments and resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.
Led client QBRs and performance reviews, translating data into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail (deals ~$10K-$45K), including agencies focused on healthcare clients, retaining all but one (~94%).
Led onboarding and training for a high-volume partner network, guiding customers through complex setup and configuration of reputation and marketing-automation tools.
Built automated product-training and communication sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Fed structured, prioritized customer feedback to Product and Engineering, and analyzed utilization data to catch adoption gaps before they became churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp and rebuilding handoff processes that reduced errors and improved reporting accuracy.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ customers per month, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Owned launches from handoff through configuration, training, and go-live as primary point of contact, delivering on time and accelerating time to value.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), and contributed to hiring, training, and process for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable.
Defined the CRM fields required for onboarding workflows, standardizing customer records across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute.
Guided onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting setup issues and escalating risks early.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
